title: Enrolled Agent flashcards: for Part 1 (Individuals) of the IRS Special Enrollment Examination
releaseBlockers: the deck teaches tax year 2025 law, tested from 1 July 2026 to 28 February 2027: rebuild every dollar amount for the next window
description: Individual income tax for Part 1 of the Enrolled Agent exam, tax year 2025, from IRS publications and instructions: every rule explained before it is tested, and every card quoting the IRS words it rests on.

glossary.AGI: adjusted gross income: total income minus the adjustments to income (taught in topic 4)
glossary.FinCEN: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, the Treasury bureau that receives FBAR filings

sourceShort: IRS publications and form instructions for tax year 2025
notice: This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by the Internal Revenue Service, the Department of the Treasury or PSI Services. Content is adapted from IRS publications, which are US Government works; credit: Internal Revenue Service.

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 749 cards against the 2025 IRS publications and instructions; every card quotes the IRS words it rests on, found word for word on the cited page by the card checker
checks.result: 7 wrong answers (among them a misprinted 401(k) catch-up limit copied from Publication 17), 2 unsupported claims, 3 ambiguous cards, 5 unclear ones and 8 minor issues were fixed; a third check confirmed all 7 wrong cards are now right, with the arithmetic and dates reworked.
